purpose: Study how large language models turn separately available constraints into integrated intelligibility, and how that integration can be disclosed so a reader learns to see the difference between additive inputs and centrally propagated realization.

entries.title: Project seed
entries.body: Inheritance, conjunction, prompt-constructed context, and generative resolution are the current working pieces.

entries.title: Boundary
entries.body: Structure is not meaning. Intelligibility is not truth.

entries.title: Deeper question
entries.body: What must language be, for GPT to be possible?

entries.title: Disclosure mandate
entries.body: The astrology project should not merely use conjunction behind the scenes. It should disclose the difference between additive interpretation and centrally propagated realization by performing the melding in public so the reader learns to see it.

entries.title: Provenance-bearing intelligibility
entries.body: Meld completely. Preserve provenance completely. The integrated result may cease to display its component meanings additively, but the system must retain where each distinction came from, which chart fact activated it, what was source-derived, what was conjunctively inferred, and what belongs to the present articulation.

entries.title: Emphaticagogical disclosure
entries.body: A person-facing interpretation should be staged so that the learner experiences why a chart is not a list of independent meanings. The term emphaticagogical is provisional; the mandate is to teach central propagation through the form of the disclosure itself.

entries.title: Founding native as experimental condition
entries.body: The first Jyotisa native is not merely the subject of the first interpretive case. The native, chart, inherited Jyotisa grammar, prompt, GPT, provenance record, and human response together form an experimental field. The founding native can also serve as the first site of the project's native explanatory form: a disclosure in which the reader experiences separately intelligible chart factors becoming mutually consequential until one person-level realization emerges. The aim is methodological rather than flattering or person-exceptionalist; the resulting method should later survive other natives, other domains, and eventually synthetic grammars not present in model training.

provenance.formation: Conversation-level conjunction of the existing disclosure mandate, provenance principle, Jyotisa test field, and the recognition that the human native can evaluate the visibility and accountability of integration.
provenance.reopen_if: The founding case fails to distinguish conjunctive output from a competent additive control, or the proposed method does not transfer beyond the founding native.
